description: This file defines a class DevicesTableConfigResolver that configures and manages the device table in the Thingsboard UI, including loading device data, handling actions like add, delete, assign, unassign, and managing device credentials, as well as configuring table columns and actions based on device scope.

classes.name: DevicesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that configures the device table, handles data loading, user actions, and table configuration based on device scope and user permissions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and configures the device table based on route parameters and user authority.

methods.name: onLoadAction
methods.description: Handles additional query parameters from the route to filter device data.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Configures table columns based on device scope.

methods.name: deviceState
methods.description: Returns HTML string representing device active/inactive state.

methods.name: deviceStateStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for device state indicator.

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets fetch and delete functions for device entities based on scope.

methods.name: prepareDeviceInfoQuery
methods.description: Prepares device info query with filters based on scope.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Configures row action buttons based on device scope.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Configures group action buttons based on device scope.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Configures add/import actions based on device scope.

methods.name: openDevice
methods.description: Navigates to device detail page.

methods.name: importDevices
methods.description: Opens import dialog for devices.

methods.name: deviceWizard
methods.description: Opens device creation wizard dialog.

methods.name: addDevicesToCustomer
methods.description: Opens dialog to add devices to a customer.

methods.name: makePublic
methods.description: Marks a device as public.

methods.name: assignToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns devices to a customer.

methods.name: unassignFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns a device from a customer.

methods.name: unassignDevicesFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns multiple devices from a customer.

methods.name: manageCredentials
methods.description: Opens dialog to manage device credentials.

methods.name: onDeviceAction
methods.description: Handles device row actions.

methods.name: addDevicesToEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to add devices to an edge.

methods.name: unassignFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a device from an edge.

methods.name: unassignDevicesFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns multiple devices from an edge.

methods.name: checkConnectivity
methods.description: Opens dialog to check device connectivity.
